Through the CLI a reply sometimes opened with a note about a plan file before the text; that note is scored as part of the read

panels.heading: Printed Syriac, 20 pages from 18 editions (#6295)
notes: Directional: 20 books, under the 30 a decision needs; intervals resample editions (2,000 draws)

Pages were drawn from those whose Kraken lane read could be located in the Digital Syriac Corpus, so the draw leans towards pages Kraken reads; 4 of the 24 sealed pages had no e-text window and are not scored
Error is counted on the consonants (vowel points and Syriac punctuation folded, a Latin column ignored), scripts/eval/syriac-pareto-6295/syriac-cer.mjs
Column split (the lane's gutter cut) against no split: median difference 0 [0, 0]; the cut changed the score on 4 pages, so no difference shown (CI includes 0)
Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite read every page twice: 0 of 20 reads identical, median difference 5.3 points

Gemini 3.8 Flash, CLI is gemini-3.8-flash-low run through Google's Antigravity command-line tool on a subscription (2026-10-08), which billed nothing; it is drawn at the API's list price for the same requests

Gemini's safety filter stopped 5 of its 20 scored reads part-way down the page; they are scored as returned. On the 15 pages it was not stopped on, its median error is 41% [36%–45%], against 14% for the Kraken lane on the same pages
Its repeat read: 0 of 24 repeat reads identical, median difference 4.9 points on the 20 scored pages

Gemini 3.7 Flash, CLI is gemini-3.7-flash-low run through Google's Antigravity command-line tool on a subscription (2026-10-08), which billed nothing; it is drawn at the API's list price for the same requests

Gemini's safety filter stopped 3 of its 20 scored reads part-way down the page; they are scored as returned. On the 17 pages it was not stopped on, its median error is 39% [31%–47%], against 12% for the Kraken lane on the same pages
Its repeat read: 0 of 24 repeat reads identical, median difference 5.7 points on the 20 scored pages

Gemini 3.6 Flash, CLI is gemini-3.6-flash-low run through Google's Antigravity command-line tool on a subscription (2026-10-08), which billed nothing; it is drawn at the API's list price for the same requests

Gemini's safety filter stopped 1 of its 20 scored reads part-way down the page; they are scored as returned. On the 19 pages it was not stopped on, its median error is 52% [45%–61%], against 14% for the Kraken lane on the same pages
Its repeat read: 0 of 24 repeat reads identical, median difference 9.5 points on the 20 scored pages

Kraken and MinerU priced on this box's CPU time (a Hetzner cax41, about €32 a month), Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite at its metered Batch rate, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.6 Flash at their list Batch price
